description:
[read-only] Who the brand's lead follow-up email comes from: mode flayr ("<Brand> via flayr"), domain (the brand's own domain, only once verified) or mailbox (its connected mailbox); the reply-to; the domain's DNS records, status, warm-up and bounce health; and a preview of each From line. Use an `id` from list_brands.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/brands/{id}/sending-identity.)

id.description: A brand id from GET /api/v2/brands. A brand-bound key may only name its own brand (another brand → 403).

name: brand_sending_identity_get
title: Get a brand's sending identity
